description: This Dart source file defines the ReactAgentController class, a Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages the state and interactions of the React Agent screen, including starting the agent, handling steps, user input, and UI-related data like icons and colors.

classes.name: ReactAgentController
classes.description: A controller class for managing the React Agent screen, providing state management, user input handling, and interaction with the AgentService, extending ChangeNotifier for reactive UI updates.

methods.name: ReactAgentController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with an optional AgentService and setting up a listener for agent state changes.

methods.name: _onAgentChanged
methods.description: Internal callback invoked when the AgentService updates its state, synchronizing steps, running status, and notifying listeners.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Starts the agent process if user input is non-empty, handling validation and error messages.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Resets the agent state, clears steps, errors, and user input.

methods.name: setUserInput
methods.description: Updates the user input string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon corresponding to the given StepType.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns a color corresponding to the given StepType.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns a string title corresponding to the given StepType.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes the listener from the AgentService and performs cleanup.
